_about: Firefly Meadow. Firefly glows are short mono tones, one note of C major pentatonic each, placed in the meadow by the game; blooms are the same notes held, for a released jar's chord. Beds and landmarks loop quietly under speech. Render with python3 tools/render_sounds.py firefly-meadow.

sounds._about: Menu select: a jar closing on a glow.
Pause music: a music box over harp, a dusk waltz.
